review.review_scope: Read all 27 deterministic native sample strata: eight source systems, twelve Axiom archetypes, and seven nonzero/value-state counterexamples. Reviewed the strict reader, scheduled/history and replacement contracts, typed identifiers, field/unit controls, budget allocation, and bounded fault dispositions. Final acceptance requires the complete content-bound end-to-end suite and four-exit gate.
findings: Patient names, DOB, address, MRN and source-known identity revisions remain coherent; stable identifiers are separate from version identities.

Employee EMP-300006 and manager EMP-300001 use native identifiers with WO-prefixed centers. Effective dates, recording dates and source arrivals are separate; a late revision of a closed historical interval is valid history, not a current active-worker row.
Bed READY/EMPTY/IN_SERVICE, staffing and reservation flags retain distinct meanings. Effective sequence and correction references, not archive ordinals, determine bed state.
The sampled 1.25-hour circulating shift separates 1 productive hour and 0.25 paid nonproductive hour. Inventory consumption of -10 at USD 0.39 retains -3.90 extended cost and known future lot expiry.
Claim submission retains zero new recognized revenue while moving claim AR; source journals retain their own posting, service, knowledge and delivery dates.

Budget and forecast vintages append. Actual close vintages replace exact scopes, including legitimate unchanged final confirmations; no business delta is fabricated to make a replacement appear different.

The annual nonzero mirror varies from 352.50 to 1208.75 USD across its sampled year. Actual 465182.50 less budget 480150.38 produces -14967.88 and -3.117332 percent. NO_BUDGET and ZERO_BUDGET retain different null/zero semantics.

Axiom FTE 19.841467 is a captured productive-hours statistic, not employee headcount. DailyPlanRate 7466.498710 is the accepted monthly forecast 231461.46 divided by 31 calendar days, not a new causal predictor.
The approximately 900-export customer inventory was not supplied. Twelve illustrative archetypes and approximately 888 unmodeled inventory slots are disclosed without vendor certification.
remaining_nonblocking_limitations: No actual Workday/Axiom tenant layout or approximately 900-file inventory has been tested; all native shapes are explicitly simulated extensions.

Weekly Workday files are source-known revision-history snapshots, not current active-headcount rosters. Employment and credential eligibility remain separate from simply listing a history row. Roster/time capture is a separate source.
AuditKnowledgeClosedAt is retrospective reconstruction metadata and is omitted from finite as-of replay views. Raw full-history archives must not be treated as historical model features.
Derived reports carry scalar canonical trace identifiers for independent reconciliation. They are mirrors, never additive primary actuals or new canonical facts.

The accepted domain capture remains the declared selected-service and workforce/finance scope. Phase 8 statistical and independent downstream-consumer validation and Phase 9 release certification remain outstanding.
